qualification.details: Must be an individual (bisexual/male/female) who takes interest in uplifting weaker and marginalized sections of society without financial gain, including retired teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, members of non-governmental organizations and clubs, self-help groups, Jeevika, and any other person (excluding practicing advocates) who is interested in social service and considered suitable by DLSA. Must be a permanent resident of Sheohar district. Physically and mentally healthy with good moral character, and no pending criminal cases or prior convictions by any court. Candidates previously selected as Para Legal Volunteers can re-apply and will be given preference.

Sheohar. Personal interview for shortlisted candidates (interview schedule and notifications will be updated on the Civil Court Sheohar website). Preference will be given to previously selected para legal volunteers.
how_to_apply: Download the application format (Prapatr-1 and Prapatr-2) from the Civil Court Sheohar official website at sheohar.dcourts.gov.in or obtain a copy directly from the office.
Fill out the prescribed application form completely in your own handwriting.
Attach self-attested photocopies of your educational and other qualification certificates.
Affix a passport-size photograph with self-attestation on the application form.
Enclose a self-addressed envelope affixed with a registered postal stamp.
Write your contact number and e-mail ID compulsorily on the application form.

Send the completed application form via registered post to reach the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, A.D.R. Bhawan, Sheohar on or before 30 November 2026 by 05:00 PM (applications can also be submitted in person at the office during working hours between 10:00 AM and 05:00 PM). Applications received after the scheduled date and time will not be considered.
important_instructions: This engagement is purely voluntary for legal awareness and legal aid to victims and acts as a bridge between the public and DLSA / ADR centers; it is not a government job appointment and carries no regular service benefits or reservation claims, though adequate representation is given to all categories. Applications must be sent by registered post or submitted in person to the specified office address before the deadline. Applications lacking required self-attested copies, contact numbers, email IDs, or postal stamps on the return envelope will be rejected without consideration. Candidates must regularly check the Civil Court Sheohar website for interview dates and related updates.

faq.question: Q1. What is DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement process conducted by District Legal Services Authority Sheohar to select 100 Para Legal Volunteers on a voluntary contract basis for legal literacy and aid coordination.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 100 vacancies available for Para Legal Volunteers across Sheohar district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 30 November 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The minimum and maximum age limits are not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay or honorarium for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Para Legal Volunteers receive Rs. 750 per day, which is payable only on specific days when assigned tasks by the authority or when bringing individuals to the ADR center for legal aid / participating in awareness camps.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must download the application form from the website, fill it out completely, attach self-attested documents, and send it by registered post or submit it by hand to the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, ADR Bhavan, Sheohar.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is explicitly a voluntary service assignment and not a regular government job appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply as a Para Legal Volunteer in Sheohar?
faq.answer: Permanent residents of Sheohar district who are Matric pass and possess an interest in social service without financial gain—including retired teachers, government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, and club members—are eligible to apply, excluding practicing advocates.
